verdict.rationale: Statsig is a product analytics and experimentation platform, so cross-device identity resolution is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never documents identifying users across devices or merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile. The mention of device-level and custom ID experiments only describes experiment randomization units, an adjacent feature that is not identity merging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile
